Where Zillow (Preferred / Premier Agent) shines

Best home search in the business. Huge listing search; Zillow Home Loans.

Most common complaint

Shoppers often think they're contacting the listing agent; class actions filed 2025–26 over fees and loan steering (allegations).

Is Zillow (Preferred / Premier Agent) free?

Yes for consumers — the agent pays Zillow (Preferred / Premier Agent) a referral fee (Up to 40% reported, or pay-per-lead). Money Move Homes is also free; our partner agents pay 25%, disclosed up front.

What's the best Zillow (Preferred / Premier Agent) alternative?

If you want to choose your one agent from a published scorecard and keep your number private, Money Move Homes was built for that. If you need a fast cash sale, an iBuyer may fit better — we'll tell you honestly.

Does Zillow (Preferred / Premier Agent) sell my information?

Check their privacy policy and consent screen for "marketing partners." Common complaint: shoppers often think they're contacting the listing agent; class actions filed 2025–26 over fees and loan steering (allegations). Money Move Homes shares your info only with the one agent you choose.
